The language server toolkit

The foundation for
any language's tooling.

Write your language analysis once, as one Rust trait. lspkit serves it to your VS Code extension over the Language Server Protocol and to Claude Code, Cursor and Codex as an MCP server. Find the hot path and the memory leak with a profiler built into VS Code.
